events.title: Union County
events.description: OPENS AUGUST 28 | Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amidst the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio. With Will Poulter and Noah Centineo.

events.title: Coyote vs. Acme
events.description: OPENS AUGUST 28 | After enduring years of catastrophic product failures at the hands of ACME, Inc., a tenacious, unemployed coyote uncovers a corporate cover-up and spearheads an unhinged battle against the multinational conglomerate that’s been blowing him up in the name of profit. Also, there’s a roadrunner. And dynamite.

events.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
events.description: OPENS AUG. 21 | From director Jane Schoenbrun (I Saw The TV Glow). After years of sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, the two fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.
